[p]Hunters and Ghosts, it's time once again to gear up for our latest update! Update 1.6 brings a brand-new map ripe for haunting, the [b]Farm[/b]. Let's dive into it![/p]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]🧑‍🌾NEW MAP: FARM 🧑‍🌾[/h1]
Get ready for the Farm 🧑‍🌾, our brand-new map set on a sprawling rural homestead. Whether you're haunting the creaky old barn or hunting through the farmhouse, this map offers fresh tactical twists for both Ghosts and Hunters.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WOsCd6W.gif[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]The Barn[/h1]
The barn used to echo with the sounds of daily chores—now it stands silent, thick with dust and the scent of old hay. Look closely and you’ll find hiding spots tucked between leaning stacks and forgotten equipment.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vic2cL7.jpeg[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]The Farm House[/h1]
The old house sits in eerie stillness, its warmth long since drained away. Floorboards groan underfoot, and shattered windows whisper secrets. Room after room offers cover—but not comfort.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/r0jq3ns.jpeg[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]The Storage Building[/h1]
What was once a simple tool shed has taken on a darker purpose. The air feels heavier near the back, where the Ghost Shrine waits. Between crates and rusted tools, something watches.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Xc5cJl8.jpeg[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]🖥️24/7 Farm Dedicated Servers🖥️[/h1]
We’re excited to announce that with this update, one dedicated server in every region will be running the new Farm map 24/7! 🌽 This means you’ll always have a guaranteed way to jump straight into the action and experience everything the Farm has to offer—day or night, rain or shine. Whether you’re chasing Ghosts through the farmhouse or hiding in the Barn, this setup gives players a reliable spot to master the new layout and uncover all its hidden tricks.

[hr][/hr]
[h1]🐛 Bug Fixes and Balance Changes 🐛[/h1]
[list]
[*] Nerfed Ecto-Rush to remove Ghost Form, Doppelganger, and Spirit buffs
[*] Slowed the initial cooldown for Copycat
[*] Slightly buffed Quickcharge
[*] Slightly tweaked collision on Ghost Town to allow for better traversal with Grappling Hook
[*] Fixed rare game crash happening when returning to main menu after a match
[*] Fixed rare issue with Overkill that was causing incorrect health values after swapping gear
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]💵UPDATE SALE💵[/h1]
Midnight Ghost Hunt is 75% off right now! If you haven’t had a chance to check the game out yet, now is a great time to do so!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/915810/Midnight_Ghost_Hunt/

notes.title: UPDATE 1.5: A NEW MAP, A NEW HERO PROP, A NEW GHOST SKIN, AND TONS OF NEW PROPS!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zTaOnii.jpeg[/img]

Hunters and Ghosts, it’s time to gear up for our latest update! Update 1.5 brings a brand-new map, a powerful new Hero Prop, a new Ghost skin, and a treasure trove of fresh props to haunt and hunt. Let’s dive into what’s new!

[h1]🤠NEW MAP: GHOST TOWN 🤠[/h1]

Saddle up for [b]Ghost Town[/b] 🤠, our brand-new map set in a classic Wild West town. Whether you're haunting the abandoned saloon or hunting in the bank, this map brings new strategic opportunities for both Ghosts and Hunters.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/00N8jOf.gif[/img]

[h2]The Saloon[/h2]
Once the lively heart of the town, now a dimly lit haunt with empty tables. Plenty of cover, but watch out for the piano!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/S2B3xVd.jpeg[/img]

[h2]The Bank[/h2]
Guarded by the formidable Bank Safe, this former stronghold of wealth offers tight corridors and tense engagements.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/03aKtJM.jpeg[/img]

[h2]The General Store[/h2]
Stocked with abandoned goods and cluttered with props, a perfect place for Ghosts to hide in plain sight.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/yOs3FZS.jpeg[/img]

[h2]The Hotel[/h2]
Multiple floors of eerie hallways and vacant rooms make this an unpredictable battleground with lots of ambush potential.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UZLv9CO.jpeg[/img]

[h2]The Church[/h2]
A solemn, shadowy space where spirits may linger longer than expected. The echoing interior makes it both a refuge and a risk.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JlwDI1t.jpeg[/img]

[h2]The Sheriff’s Office[/h2]
Jail cells, desks, and old wanted posters set the scene for a classic standoff. But in this town, the ghosts don’t stay behind bars!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Oe8fdSt.jpeg[/img]

[h1]🏦 NEW HERO PROP: BANK SAFE 🏦[/h1]
Introducing the [b]Bank Safe[/b], a brand-new hero prop that packs a serious punch! This hefty vault isn’t just a place to hide—it’s a weapon. Ghosts can spring the heavy door open to slam unsuspecting Hunters, dealing devastating damage!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qlmMykG.gif[/img]

[h1]👻 NEW GHOST SKIN: COWBOY 👻[/h1]
Introducing our latest ghostly addition—the Cowboy skin! Saddle up and haunt the frontier with this spectral gunslinger, complete with a tattered duster, weathered hat, and a haunting glow that’ll make any hunter think twice before crossing your path.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/yvitmn0.jpeg[/img]

[h1]🪑 NEW PROPS 🪑[/h1]
Our upcoming map introduces a fresh batch of props to shake up your hiding strategies. The town's general store is also stocked with all-new goodies, from old-fashioned lanterns to sacks of supplies. You'll find everything you'd expect in an old west town—weathered barrels, dusty lanterns, and even a worn-out old radio, all perfect for ghosts looking to hide in plain sight.

Midnight Ghost Hunt is 75% off right now! If you haven’t had a chance to check the game out yet, now is a great time to do so!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/915810/Midnight_Ghost_Hunt/

That’s it for this update, Ghosts and Hunters—time to saddle up and haunt [b]Ghost Town[/b]! 🤠

Blast off into the paranormal with our new Astronaut Hunter skin, as your ghost hunter suits up for an out-of-this-world adventure!

[h2]⚖️BIG BALANCE CHANGES⚖️[/h2]
Major thanks to all players who have provided feedback and given suggestions! We have been listening, and have prepared quite a few balance related changes for this update!
[list]
[*] Increased the number of health orbs available at Midnight, from 4 to 8
[*] Increased the health Ghosts re-spawn with at Midnight, 75 if not vacuumed, 50 if vacuumed
[*] Harpoon Bazooka shots now break Deflectors bubble
[*] Hallucinate now plays more “game specific” sounds, such as Death Grip, Corruption, etc
[*] Increased Riot Shield damage to props and Ghosts
[*] Conjurer will try to find a better sized prop to spawn if there isn’t enough room to spawn one
[*] Moved spawn location of Conjurer props closer to the ground to prevent the props from falling over
[*] Midnight Ghosts can now break C4 with one swipe, previously this took two
[*] Midnight Ghosts can now break Medkits with one swipe, previously this took two
[*] Slightly increased the distance Ghosts need to move before Ectoplasm starts to drop
[*] This is to help prevent Ghosts from only slightly moving back and forth to drop Ecto
[*] Lowered projectile audio volume for both Project X and Frostbite
[*] Phantom duration no longer decreases with Ghost movement
[*] Slightly decreased Chill Haunt duration
[*] Slightly decreased Chill Haunt movement speed reduction
[*] Decreased cooldown for Doppelganger if it fails to activate due to available space
[*] Increased Heavyweight damage reduction from 25% to 30%
[*] Decreased Berserk movement speed to 20%, down from 30%
[*] Reduced Quickcharge charge time, meaning this is slower to charge up than before
[*] Slightly increased Spectral Cannon damage and splash damage radius
[*] Slightly increased Sledgehammer damage against Ghosts (but not props)
[*] Slightly decrease the number of shots needed to freeze large props with Frostbite
[*] Tweaked Miasma to now tick twice as fast but for half the damage, overall damage is the same, but now more likely to hit Hunters running at full speed
[*] Murder Doll/Witch no longer gets free "Shatterproof" - this prop will never break when hitting a Hunter, but will break like normal otherwise
[*] Medium-sized props are now 20% more resilient against breaking on impact, requires 20% more velocity on impact to break as compared to small props
[*] Increased health on bouncing ball props
[/list]

notes.title: DBD meets Prey in hit Steam horror game, and it's now less than $10
notes.content:
One of the best parts of Dishonored and Deathloop creator Arkane Studios' 2017 sci-fi game Prey was its alien threats' ability to disguise themselves as ordinary items in the game world. The routine of scanning a room, picking through debris for resources and information, would suddenly transform into a frantic fight against a creature that could hide in plain sight. This aspect of Prey eventually spawned its Typhon Hunt mode, which itself resembled Prop Hunt from Garry's Mod, and has now, with the full launch of Midnight Ghost Hunt, been combined with the multiplayer asymmetric horror of Dead By Daylight into a hit Steam game that you can currently pick up for less than $10.

notes.content:
Prop hunt games or modes are often the source of the most fun and chaotic gameplay you could want, with half a team of players turning themselves into everyday objects at will, and the other half desperately trying to draw them out of their surroundings. At the slightest hint of movement, hunters end up chasing chairs, statues, musical instruments, and most anything else you can think of around the map. Multiple games have been set around the game mechanic, like Prop Hunt itself and Propnight, while it appears as a popular mode in the likes of Call of Duty, Fortnite, and Garry's Mod, where prop hunt was originally popularized. Now, another new game has arrived that adopts prop hunt as its main mechanic, pitting a team of hunters against a group of ghosts, capable of possessing most objects around them. This is Midnight Ghost Hunt.

notes.title: 1.0 FULL RELEASE OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Following nearly 2 years in Early Access, Midnight Ghost Hunt 1.0 is OUT NOW! 

It’s been a long and exciting road as we ramp up to this full release! 

Here’s a rundown of what has changed for our 1.0 release:

[h2]✨ALL 10 MAPS FULLY REVAMPED✨[/h2]
We've been tirelessly working behind the scenes, overhauling all the maps to ensure they reach their absolute best versions! Our objectives with these changes were:
[list]
[*] Large layout changes on most maps
[list]
[*] Less reliance on ladders for verticality on maps like Ghost Ship or Asylum
[*] Improved map flow for getting around the map easier
[/list][*] Add more line of sight breaks for escapes
[list][*] By breaking up line of sight, Ghosts can get away from Hunters easier by having more walls/corners to hide behind
[/list][*] Add more hiding spots and have less dead ends
[list]
[*] The redesigns of most of the maps allowed us to rethink a lot of the hiding spots for Ghosts as well, which has led to many more exciting “run-away” moments
[*] We also ensured that every spot on every map has multiple ways to escape, always giving the Ghost a chance to get away from those relentless Hunters 😉
[/list][*] Improved lighting and contrast
[list]
[*] During Early Access, most of our maps were very blue. With the new lighting pass, we have added warmth and contrast back to the maps, which also reduces a lot of the visual noise; allowing Ghosts to stand out even more 👻
[/list][/list] 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/yf0dkxe.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/YgpCria.gif[/img]

[h2]🔫WEAPON SKINS🔫[/h2]
We wanted another way for players to spend their hard earned Ghost Shards, and weapons skins seemed like the obvious choice! For 1.0 every weapon has at least 1 new skin that can be unlocked via Ghost Shards. Each weapon also has a ✨golden ✨ skin, which can only be unlocked by getting the Mastery achievement for that weapon!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/YXmrcfA.gif[/img]

[h2]🤖 ALL NEW BOT AI, DIFFICULTLY LEVELS, PROFILE PICTURES, AND MORE!🤖[/h2]
Both the Hunter and Ghost bots have gotten a MAJOR upgrade! Their revamped AI will employ improved strategies and navigation - and will make for indispensable allies or formidable foes!

We wanted to make sure that if you just wanted to chill in a lobby with a couple of friends, that you could turn the bots on the fill out your teams, and feel good knowing that they will actually be able to play with you as Hunters or Ghosts.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9UwwzXY.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RsKXYcr.png[/img]

Our new and improved Ghost visuals enriches the appearance and aura of our spectral friends. From the default skin to the Krampus and everything in-between, our overhauled Ghost visuals are a significant upgrade.

Much like with the map changes, we felt the Ghost visuals were much too bright and blue, so we redid all of them to add even more visual clarity to your chosen spectral skin.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0DAQXQw.jpeg[/img]

Spectral Cannon, Project X, Ghostsmasher, Grenade, and more all received new and improved visual effects for improved clarity! The goal was to make the weapon effects warmer colors so they contrast better against all the Ghostly blue.

notes.title: UPDATE 11: 2ND HUNTER GADGET SLOT, MAIN MENU UI OVERHAUL, AND MORE!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hYlEpk8.gif[/img]

Season’s greetings, Ghosts and Hunters!

As the holiday season blankets the world in warmth and cheer, our ghostly game is no exception to the festive magic. 'Tis the season for festive spirits, so grab your gear and get ready for a hauntingly delightful Christmas hunt!

[h1]❄️2ND HUNTER GADGET SLOT ❄️[/h1]
Previously, Hunters had only one gadget slot that would force a player to pick either a tracking gadget or something else. Internally, we’ve experimented with adding a second gadget slot to Hunters that gave lesser-used gadgets a time to shine without needing to give up the ability to track Ghosts. The results were promising, so we are rolling this change out in this update!

Hunters now have the choice of a weapon, a regular gadget, a utility gadget, and a perk. We have currently split the gadgets in a way that we think makes the most sense to prevent a solo Hunter from being overly strong, but please note this is experimental, and we would love to hear your feedback!

The “regular” gadgets are Radar, Vacuum, Camcorder, Spectrophone, Pathfinder, and Trap. While the “utility” gadget options are Defibrillator, Medic Kit, Grenade, Grappling Hook, and C4.

Our goal with this change is to allow the Hunters to use more of the niche gadgets while still retaining a tracking gadget. We can’t wait to see what new crazy builds you come up with!

In an attempt to balance out this change, we have decreased Hunter movement speed by about 10% to compensate for the extra power that Hunters gain to hopefully prevent a major swing in balance. We will be keeping a close eye on the analytics and your feedback, and we will adjust as needed!

[h1]💻 MAIN MENU UI OVERHAUL💻[/h1]
The first thing you will notice when booting up Update 11 will be the newly overhauled main menu! This new main menu allows for easier navigation through the various menus, brings the style up to date, and adds a widely-requested new feature: you can now toggle between Ghost and Hunter skins for your party in the main menu!

You may also spot a new feature in the new main menu, separate emote and victory pose selections for Hunters and Ghosts! You know you have always wanted to Praise the Duck as a Hunter and do the Forbidden Gesture as a Ghost, right? RIGHT? Well, now you can!

notes.title: UPDATE 10: SCARY SEASON, ECTOPLASM & MIDNIGHT BALANCE CHANGES, AND MORE!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ygKNHRm.gif[/img]

Hey there, Ghosts and Hunters!

As the crisp, cool breeze of autumn fills the air, it can mean only one thing: Halloween season is here! So don your favorite duck costume, and join us in the excitement as we delve into Update 10!

[h1]🎃SCARY SEASON DECORATIONS 🎃[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dg9UpEY.png[/img]
What would scary season be without some seasonal decorations? We’ve once again decorated all the maps and the van with ghostly adornments galore. The three Halloween hero props are back once again for you to enjoy!

[b]Chomping Pumpkin[/b] - Much like our Mimic Chest friend, this pumpkin will have no problem taking a bite or two out of you

[b]Pumpkin Jack-in-the-box[/b] - Is the hammer from our regular Jack-in-the-box too aggressive for you? How about launching pumpkin guts at them instead?

[b]Witch Doll[/b] - Who needs a knife when you have a broom? Zoom across the maps and bonk the hunters to your heart’s content

[h1]🕸️ ECTOPLASM/RADAR CHANGES 🕸️[/h1]
With this update we have also made some pretty serious balance changes, and that starts with how Ectoplasm buildup works.

We have heard from the community that Radar detecting Ghosts with 0 Ectoplasm buildup didn’t make much sense, so we changed it! Our intention is for Radar to be much more accurate, while also making Ectoplasm buildup more clear for Ghosts.
[list]
[*] 0 Ectoplasm buildup now means 0 reading on Radar/Spectrophone
[*] Moving in a small circle as a Ghost will no longer reduce Ectoplasm buildup 
[*] Radar will no longer get confused between different floors
[list]
[*] Before, Radar could show a high reading if a Ghost with high Ectoplasm buildup was on the floor above you, that is no longer the case[/list][*] Radar will no longer get confused if you have a low Ectoplasm ghost directly in front of you, and a high Ectoplasm ghost slightly further away
[list]
[*] Before, this would cause Radar to show almost no signal, even though you have a high Ectoplasm ghost nearby[/list][*] Taunting still lowers Ectoplasm buildup, however we have increased the volume to make this more risky in revealing your location
[*] The Ectoplasm buildup bar now will show a shaking Radar icon the higher your Ectoplasm buildup gets to clarify what having high Ectoplasm actually means: High Ectoplasm = High Radar reading
[/list]
[h1]🕷️ MIDNIGHT BALANCE CHANGES🕷️[/h1]
We’ve focused this update on improving balance and how Midnight plays out during matches. Hunters missing even a single Ghost previously meant that all Ghosts come back at full health, or they could easily heal any damage they took pre-midnight.

This new system is designed to still allow Ghosts to feel powerful at Midnight, while assuring Hunters that the last 5 minutes weren’t for nothing. Destroying 3 out of the 4 ghosts before Midnight will now make a drastic difference to the possible outcome for Hunters at Midnight.
[list]
[*] At midnight, all health orbs will despawn, and they will not respawn for the rest of the match
[*] If you die as a Ghost before midnight, you will come back with less health
[list]
[*] If you were not vacuumed, you will come back with 60hp
[*] If you were vacuumed, you will come back with 35hp[/list][*] There are only two ways to heal as a ghost after Midnight
[list][*] Consuming a Hunter soul will do one of the following:
[list][*] If you are <100% HP, you will heal some damage
[*] If you are 100% HP, a health orb will spawn at this location for a teammate[/list][*] Destroying the Generator will drop 2 health orbs, allowing you/your team to heal[/list][*] UI will indicate how much health you will have when you respawn at Midnight
[*] Ghosts will look less saturated at lower health after Midnight, making it easier to choose which Ghosts to target[/list]
We hope that these Midnight changes will reward Hunters for any success they do have before Midnight, while still allowing the Midnight Ghosts to feel powerful. Do give it a shot and let us know what you think over on our [url=https://discord.gg/midnightghosthunt]Discord[/url]!

[h1]💻 UI CHANGES💻[/h1]
Alongside our Midnight balance and Ectoplasm/Radar changes, we have also made some UI changes to add additional clarity:
[list]
[*] Health bars are now segmented into ~25HP chunks - this should allow you to roughly determine how much health you have in various props or Hunter perks
[*] The health bar now animates more clearly and with more polish when taking damage or healing
[*] When you are low health, you now have a more intense red outline on the outside of the screen so can more clearly understand you are low health
[/list]
[h1]🥳 DEDICATED SERVER PROPS FIXED 🥳[/h1]
A major issue that we noticed over the past few months was related to unpossessed props stuttering after a dedicated server had been online for an extended period of time. This was causing lots of other issues as well, such as Hunters teleporting around when getting hit by these specific props, as well as Ghosts being able to occasionally teleport outside of the maps when attempting to possess these props.

I am happy to report that this should be completely fixed now! So go forth and enjoy the nice, stable dedicated servers once more, and if you run into any issues please let us know on our [url=https://discord.gg/midnightghosthunt]Discord[/url]! 🥳

[h1]💵UPDATE 10 SALE💵[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/915810/Midnight_Ghost_Hunt/

To celebrate our tenth Early Access update, we’re also celebrating with a discount. If you haven’t had a try at hunting and haunting quite yet, now is a perfect time to do so! MGH is 66% off right now on Steam for the Steam Scream Fest! Gather your crew and hop on in. The sale runs until November 2nd!

[h1]🤑DOUBLE GHOST SHARDS🤑[/h1]
Trick or treat! We’ll be granting double the normal amount of Ghost Shards throughout this whole week to celebrate the Halloween season!

[h1]🎵SEVERAL NEW GHOST TAUNTS🎵[/h1]
We also added several new Ghost taunts for you to unlock and enjoy! Taunt the Hunters to your hearts content!

[h1]👀AND MORE… 👀[/h1]
This update also includes:

[*] Activating voice chat should no longer cause FPS drops

notes.title: UPDATE 9: VAN RIDE ENTERTAINMENT, CONTROLLER SUPPORT, TRADING CARDS, AND MORE!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=CxMnWtlvieE;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Hey there, Ghosts and Hunters![/b]

The summer season is over, and we have been hard at work on some of the things we called out in our July blog post. We’ve got a new update for you today, so let’s get into it!

[h1]🚗 NEW VAN RIDE ENTERTAINMENT 🚗[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/r0LxFYm.jpeg[/img]
One of the suggestions we have heard from a ton of players is that the Hunters seem a little bored and need something to do (other than the spray 😉) while they are heading to their next haunted destination on those van rides. 

Hunters will be idle no more! Introducing: the GhostMaster handheld gaming console! You can play “Ghost Invaders” and pass the time on your next ride. You can also customize the handheld with multiple color choices (including transparent purple ✨)!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MuVwqi5.png[/img]

[h1]🎮 FULL CONTROLLER SUPPORT 🎮 [/h1]
Full controller support is another highly anticipated feature. Although we’ve had experimental controller support since our Early Access launch, we’ve been working hard to perfect the experience of playing with a controller. We’re thrilled with the results and can’t wait for you to try it out! Whether you prefer using a mouse and keyboard or a controller, we’re confident that you’ll have a fantastic experience. As always, we welcome your feedback on [url=https://discord.gg/midnightghosthunt]Discord[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/playmgh]Twitter (X)[/url] about this new feature!

[h1]🎉 STEAM TRADING CARDS 🎉[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/X7dezn2.png[/img]
Introducing Steam Trading Cards for MGH! Now, as you play MGH, you’ll have the chance to collect wicked virtual cards featuring artwork inspired by the MGH universe. Once you’ve collected a full set of cards, you can turn them into game badges and tradable Steam community items. The sooner you collect ‘em all, the sooner you can flex on your friends. 😉

[h1]🕹️ QUICKPLAY IMPROVEMENTS 🕹️[/h1]
After observing the quickplay data, and of course listening to your feedback, we have made more adjustments to the quickplay algorithm that should now result in finding better, faster matches! Specifically, quickplay will look for a “perfect” match, and then fallback to a “good” match faster, which should result in finding a match faster, and ending up in your own match with bots less often. Please give it a shot, and let us know what you think over on our [url=https://discord.gg/midnightghosthunt]Discord[/url]!

[h1]💵 UPDATE 9 STEAM SALE 💵[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/915810/Midnight_Ghost_Hunt/

To celebrate our ninth Early Access update, we’re also celebrating with a discount. If you haven’t had a try at hunting and haunting quite yet, now is a perfect time to do so! MGH is 66% off right now on Steam! Gather your crew and hop on in. The sale runs until the 26th of September.

[h1]👀 AND MORE… 👀[/h1]
This update also includes:[list]
[*] Fix Extra Gear not working with Camcorder and bumped default ammo count from 1 to 2
[*] Female skins now have female voice callouts for both Hunter and Ghosts
[*] Deflector can no longer be activated while charging a slingshot
[*] Ghost Health Orb pickup radius increased
[*] Hunters now have a unique running sound instead of a sped-up walking sound
[*] Improvements to Buckler Shield with Ghostsmasher not always blocking hits (even more improvements for this coming soon)
[*] Doppelganger will appear with the other player’s actual gadget/weapon, no longer just Spectral Cannon
[*] Code refactor of most Hunter weapons and gadgets, leading to improved performance mostly with bots and weapon projectiles, such as Frostbite and Project-X
[*] Map exploit fixes (looking at you…Carnival 🎪)
[*] Many other smaller bug fixes as well[/list]
Although that’s all the news we have for now, rest assured that our team is hard at work behind the scenes to bring you even more exciting updates! From enhancing performance and fine-tuning bots to improving matchmaking and beyond, we’ve got plenty of tricks up our sleeves. So keep your eyes peeled for future announcements!

That’s all for now, Ghosts and Hunters! We’re grateful for your unwavering support and can’t wait to see you back on the h(a)unt soon! 😊

👻 -Team MGH

notes.content:
[url=https://i.imgur.com/7yQcApy.jpeg][img]https://i.imgur.com/7yQcApy.jpeg[/img][/url]

Hey, Ghosts and Hunters!

In our last update, we released Midnight Ghost Hunt with full crossplay compatibility and we were absolutely blown away by the support. We saw over [b]1 million[/b] new players join us on the hunt, a million! This is a remarkable achievement that fills us with gratitude and excitement for what's next. Speaking of what's next...how about an updated roadmap? 😉

Our Q3 (July - September) roadmap lays out our plans for the near future, but here are some key highlights:

[h2]🎮 Full Controller Support 🎮 [/h2]
We are planning to improve our overall controller support over the next few months to provide an equally excellent experience for all players, regardless if you are playing on mouse & keyboard or using a controller.

[h2]🚗New Van Ride Entertainment 🚗[/h2]
One of the big suggestions we hear from players is the Hunters need more to do during the van ride, so we are cooking up something special for this...be on the lookout for more info soon.

Over the next few months we will be working on sleeker menus, better tooltips, and enhanced visual cues to hopefully provide more clarity and convenience.

[h2]🎉Steam Trading Cards🎉[/h2]
With the introduction of Steam Trading Cards, you'll have the opportunity to collect, trade, and craft cards featuring stunning artwork inspired by the game's universe.

[h2]📅July Vacations📅[/h2]
Almost all of our dev team is based in Sweden, and July typically marks the start of a few weeks off for vacations in Sweden! What this means for us is a bit of a slowdown in updates during this time, as we will be working as an even smaller team for the month. However once the vacations are over, you can expect everyone to be back at it 100%, and we have some big things planned!

[h2]💵Steam Summer Sale💵[/h2]
If you haven’t joined us on the hunt quite yet, now is a great time to hop in as MGH is 66% off as part of Steam Summer Sale! The sale runs until the 13th of July, so be sure to tell your friends!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/915810/Midnight_Ghost_Hunt/


[h2]👀AND MORE… 👀[/h2]
While that is all we have to share right now, we are certainly working on other things as well; such as performance improvements, bot improvements, matchmaking improvements, and more, so be sure to keep an eye out for future announcements.

That’s all for this time, Ghosts and Hunters! Thank you again for your continued support, and we look forward to seeing you back on the h(a)unt soon!

👻 -Team MGH

notes.title: PC Crossplay, Double Shards & 66% Off Sale!
notes.content:
Hey, Ghosts and Hunters! Today we have another update ready for you!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fSb1zuo.jpeg[/img]
[h2]PC CROSSPLAY[/h2]
We are very excited to announce that MGH now has full PC Crossplay capability! What does this mean for you? More players to play with! 🥳 You can check out all the juicy details about this over on our [url=https://midnightghosthunt.com/news/2023/06/01/mgh-crossplay-announcement]dev blog post![/url]

[h2]DOUBLE GHOST SHARDS[/h2]
To welcome all our new crossplay players and welcome back our longtime supporters, we’ll be granting double the normal amount of Ghost Shards throughout this whole week!

[h2]FILE SIZE/COMPRESSION CHANGES[/h2]
Included in this update we have completely changes how MGH is packaged, resulting in a much smaller download size overall (21.6 GB to 14.8 GB)!

This change will trigger a one-time large patch download, but after that, future updates/patches should be faster to download and they will take up less space overall in the process!

We still have more work we want to do on this front going forward, but this is a great first step!

[h2]BALANCE CHANGES[/h2]
In this update we also made some minor balance changes, and would love to make more in the future based on your feedback! Last week we sent out a survey asking about [url=https://forms.gle/4TtRQs1RKqGStGvd8]Hunter Weapon balance[/url], and we have gotten some great feedback so far, and would love to get some more! If you have a couple of minutes to spare, please check out the survey!

The two balance changes we made this time are:
[list]
[*] Increase splash damage for Spectral Cannon
[list]
[*] This was a pretty minor bump, but hopefully will allow Spectral Cannon to be a more viable option in more situations[/list][*] Decrease prop damage pre-midnight
[list]
[*] While this isn’t a massive decrease, the hope is to reduce the number of Hunters being killed by ghosts before Midnight strikes[/list][/list]
[h2]THE NEXT UPDATE AND BEYOND[/h2]
While we don’t yet have a concrete date for the next major update, we’re currently working on a number of quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, and some additional content, so we appreciate the patience as we sort out what will be included in that update. We’re hoping to have some news for you in the near future, so watch this space!

That’s all for this time, Ghosts and Hunters! Thank you again for your continued support, and we look forward to seeing you back on the h(a)unt soon!

👻 -Team MGH

notes.title: 1 YEAR ANNIVERSARY: DEDICATED SERVERS, WEAPON SKINS, FREE WEEKEND AND MORE!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=r2n8TvrrNdg;full][/previewyoutube]

Has it really been a full year of MGH Early Access, already? We can’t believe it either! We’re so thankful for all of you who played Midnight Ghost Hunt during the Early Access period, and, of course, the OGs who have been here since our Beta, or even the Alpha tests, back in the day.  To celebrate the occasion, MGH is getting its seventh update, aptly named the ANNIVERSARY UPDATE. We have quite a few new things to show off so why don’t we jump right into it!

[h2]DEDICATED SERVERS[/h2]
You’ll be happy to know that as of this post, our first-pass implementation for dedicated servers is now live! We’re thankful for the patience you’ve shown during this journey since we had quite a few technical hiccups to overcome before we were able to bring this much-anticipated feature to you all. You can now play on either user-downloaded and configured dedicated servers or some of our official 24/7 dedicated servers. Peer to peer is still an option of course, but dedicated servers provide much more stability and hopefully improved performance as well!

Dedicated servers will be broken up into two categories, user hosted and “official”. The official dedicated servers will be run by us, and we will have servers available in 3 regions, US West, US East, and Europe, with Asia hopefully coming soon! These servers are up and running right now, so be sure to check them out!

User hosted servers can be hosted on pretty much any Windows machine, just open your Steam install folder and then open the WindowsServer folder and check out the “ReadMe_CustomRules.txt” to get started! When hosting a server, you can set a server name, a password, and some custom game settings!

Also in the very near future, you will be able to go to [url=https://server.nitrado.net/]https://server.nitrado.net/[/url] to rent a server directly from Nitrado. We will have more news to share on this soon!

As this is the first pass on the dedicated servers, we’re keeping a close eye on how things play out. We’d be happy to hear your feedback, so don’t hesitate to let us know your thoughts on our [url=https://discord.gg/midnightghosthunt]Discord[/url].

[h2]FREE WEEKEND, DOUBLE SHARDS & 66% SALE[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/915810/Midnight_Ghost_Hunt/

We’re always excited to introduce MGH to new folks! Now that we have reached an important milestone and are just about to wrap up our first year of Early Access, we can’t wait for more people to experience MGH with us. To celebrate Update 7, we’ll be having a free weekend on Steam! The free weekend will run from March 30th to April 3rd.

To welcome all our new players, welcome back our longtime supporters, and give a boost to all of the shard sharks out there, we’ll also be granting double the normal amount of Ghost Shards throughout this whole week (March 30th to April 6th) for all players.

Those of you who are checking out this post because you’ve given MGH a whirl over the free weekend, and like what you see, you’re in luck! We’re also running the biggest sale ever to celebrate our one-year anniversary! MGH is 66% off from March 30th to April 6th, so there’s no better time to snag a copy. If you’re a new player concerned about carrying over your progress from the free weekend, worry not! All of your progress from throughout the free weekend will carry over if you decide to give it a test run first and purchase it on the last day of the deal.

In addition to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/915810/Midnight_Ghost_Hunt/]base game[/url] being on sale, you can also get 66% off the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25291/Early_Backer_Bundle/]Early Backer Bundle[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1938860/Midnight_Ghost_Hunt__Early_Backer_Pack/]Early Backer Pack[/url], and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1951320/Midnight_Ghost_Hunt_Soundtrack/]Soundtrack[/url] if you’d like to show a bit of extra support during our one-year Early Access anniversary!

[h2]WEAPON/GADGET SKINS[/h2]
For the first time ever, we are bringing you weapon skins, with some anniversary flair, of course!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xoa9AQY.jpeg[/img]
Grenades have never looked this delicious. Don’t let the copious amount of frosting fool you, though. These cupcake grenades still pack a punch!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/6x3iXsb.jpeg[/img]
If you want to send your ghoulish ghost friends a gift, the C4 present will definitely be delivered to the right address. Open at your own risk.

[h2]2 NEW SKINS[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tNpYB0A.jpeg[/img]
The Disruptor Hunter skin is a stylish outfit designed to strike fear into the hearts of even the bravest ghosts.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cMlbx3H.jpeg[/img]
The Returned Ghost skin gives a sense of both familiarity and eeriness with it’s hauntingly realistic portrayal of a Hunter who recently met their demise.

[h2]A NEW HERO PROP AND ANNIVERSARY DECORATIONS[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nJBqaiC.jpeg[/img]
What is a birthday celebration without some cake? Beware, this cake bites back!  Our new hero prop, Chompkin Birthday Cake is a wonderful addition to the hero prop line-up. In MGH, the cake eats you. Time to bake it till you make it!

The van and the maps are decked out, as is tradition, and ready for the anniversary shenanigans. You only turn one once, after all!

[h2]BALANCE CHANGES[/h2]
We are always listening to your feedback, and with that we have made a few balance changes to address some of the common community feedback:
[list]
[*] Healing Aura now heals for 2 health per tick, up from 1
[*] Frostbite now slows tiny props more quickly
[*] Shatterproof now incurs a 20% prop movement speed penalty
[/list]
[h2]SOUNDTRACK DIGITAL RELEASE[/h2]
Ghostwood Empire, the talented duo behind the Soundtrack of Midnight Ghost Hunt, are releasing the MGH Soundtrack digitally on most platforms where you can listen to music. You can find it on [url=https://open.spotify.com/album/1HWCJ0gl5i8t54K6Iut64g?si=3GwLYlnyT7KLBPERMaA3HA]Spotify[/url], [url=https://tidal.com/browse/album/285518058]Tidal[/url], [url=https://music.apple.com/us/album/midnight-ghost-hunt-original-soundtrack/1679281822]Apple Music[/url], and more! The Soundtrack consists of 11 absolute bops, so please go check it out! The soundtrack available on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1951320/Midnight_Ghost_Hunt_Soundtrack/]Steam page[/url] has some exclusive editions of tracks, so the digital release is slightly different.

You can also check out the 35 minute music video on YouTube, the soundtrack creates that perfect MGH ambience to listen to while gaming, working, or studying, even if we say so ourselves.

[h2]LOOKING BACK ON OUR FIRST YEAR IN EARLY ACCESS[/h2]
[url=https://i.imgur.com/hwWO9cd.png][img]https://i.imgur.com/hwWO9cd.png[/img][/url]

This year has really flown past, and we’re so thankful to have you here with us as part of this journey. We’ve gotten valuable feedback during the first year of MGH Early Access, and you, our community, have been directly affecting what things the developers have been spending their time doing. Let’s take a quick look at all the things we had an opportunity to put out during the first year of MGH Early Access:

[i][b]MARCH 2022[/b][/i]
On March 31st, Midnight Ghost Hunt went into Early Access. The community really came through (thank you!), and during the launch, we even reached Steam’s Top Sellers number two spot, right behind Elden Ring.

[i][b]MAY 2022[/b][/i]
In May, it was time for our first big update. Based on community feedback from our alpha and beta tests, we decided to work on the Factory map and give it some extra love. Prior to the EA launch, we had taken Factory out of the map rotation and gave it a new life as a creepy Doll Factory. With the first update, we brought in tons of new hero props: Murder Doll, Warehouse Gate, Forklift, Soda Machine, and Speaker. Our melee weapons, Ghost Smasher and Sledgehammer also went through a rework to improve usability. Early Backer skins became available, and our friend from Satisfactory, the Pioneer, got her own skin both as a hunter and as a ghost. During Update 1, we also added lots of new victory poses, emotes, and titles.

[i][b]JUNE 2022[/b][/i]
In June we put out something of a mixture between a patch and an update, and since we are an inventive bunch, decided to name it the Summer Patch. We added the in-match challenge system, Ghost in the TV hero prop, new skins: Jock and Birthday (which is very topical right now!), plus some new emotes and victory poses.

[i][b]SEPTEMBER 2022[/b][/i]
In September we started gearing up for the spooky season, and it was time for Update 2. Mr. Giggle’s Happyland a.k.a the Carnival map was something we were extremely excited to release since the community polls and suggestions had been hoping to see a creepy Carnival or Circus-themed map in the MGH universe. The ghosts also gained a brand new ability during this update, Deflector. Hunters were awarded with some new drip, and the Paramedic, Pilot, and Old Hippie skins were added in. We like a plethora of hero props at the MGH HQ, so Jack-in-the-box in three different color variations was added in to take the mood of the carnival to the next level. In addition, we added a few more titles and a new song to the MGH Soundtrack. 

[i][b]OCTOBER 2022[/b][/i]
Oh, October. Our favorite month. Spooky season speaks to us. In October we changed things up and decided to switch up our update strategy a bit. Smaller updates, more often. That’s how we like it. Update 3, the Halloween Update, brought in spooky new Halloween-themed decorations and hero props (of course!). Chompkin Pumpkin, Pumpkin-gut-spewing Jack-in-the-box, and Witch Doll made the maps feel even more spooky, for the occasion. Our new experimental game mode, Darkness, also saw the light of day for the first time. Random level variation on Mansion was also brought on for the first time, and it’s another fantastic idea we were able to bring to life thanks to the community feedback! To celebrate Halloween, the hunters were able to get dressed in a fan-favorite Duck Hunter costume and the ghosts could don the Pumpkin Head Ghost skin. These are some of our favorite skins, so far!

[i][b]NOVEMBER 2022[/b][/i]
In November, we were feeling thankful and Update 4 was released with a brand new feature, the Boombox. Have you found all the cassette tapes since the feature was launched? Thank you for all of your support this past year, Ghosts and Hunters, we appreciate it more than you know! As always, all the details can be found on Steam. Come share your favorite MGH memories, and all the feedback with us on [url=https://discord.gg/midnightghosthunt]Discord[/url], or drop us a comment on [url=https://twitter.com/playmgh]Twitter[/url]!

notes.title: UPDATE 6: HOST MIGRATION, 2 NEW HERO PROPS, A TUNNEL OF LOVE, AND A 50% SALE!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/mHjSuYs.png[/img]

Love is in the air! The long-awaited host migration system, new lovely hero props, an expanded Love Tunnel on Carnival, and UI improvements for the progression tier system all await you in Update 6 (The Valentine’s Update)! We have quite a few things to unpack, so let’s get straight into it.

[h2]HOST MIGRATION[/h2]
The much-anticipated host migration feature is here! We’re excited to share with you that after implementation challenges and tons of internal testing, host migration functionality is now in working condition and has been running for a couple of days.

Simply put, this is how the host migration system will work:
[olist]
[*]Host leaves a match for any number of reasons
[*]The game pauses for the remaining players, selects a new host, and migrates all players to start connecting to the new host
[*]Game resumes right where you left off
[/olist]
We’re still working on the full implementation for this, so it’s possible you might run into some hiccups or issues. We’ll be keeping a close eye on things, though, and with all of you in the community also passing us feedback, we’re confident we’ll be able to address anything that pops up quickly.

[h2]2 NEW HERO PROPS[/h2]
Update 6 brings two new hero props to the MGH universe. Take aim and let Cupid’s arrow fly! The Cursed Cupid is able to flap around and shoot its arrows at unsuspecting hunters. You’ll know if you’ve hit your target by the sound of Cupid’s giddy giggles. 💘

notes.title: UPDATE 5 (THE CHRISTMAS UPDATE) AND A 50% SALE!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=WL641_HMvp4;full][/previewyoutube]
Season’s greetings, Ghosts and Hunters!

It’s once again the most wonderful time of the year, and to celebrate the season of giving, we come bearing gifts! A brand new map, new hero props, Hunter and Ghost skins, bot improvements, and a new progression tier system all await you in our latest Midnight Ghost Hunt update. So, let’s open up Santa’s bag and see what’s inside the Christmas Update!

[h2]NEW MALL MAP[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/VJZqwv5.jpeg[/img]
The new Mall map is a blast from the past, fully decked out in retro 80s style! This formerly sparkling plaza now lies in decay and ruin. The Mall’s days of loitering youths and Christmas-time commerce are long behind it. The once cheerful holiday adornments now add an eerie air to this decrepit plaza, but it’s not without its spooky charms.

The central plaza features a forgotten festive effigy — a Christmas tree with its lights twinkling endlessly into the gloom as announcements echo through the empty halls. But hey, there’s a Clockbuster Video Store, and a lovely little cafe called The Coffee Stain, so really it’s not as depressing as it might seem!

The retro-styled shops also include an Electronics Shop, the Ghosts B Us toy store, the Sus Sounds music shop, and a clothing store with a dressing room, just in case you find something on the dusty racks worth trying on!

This is an incredibly fun map with a fantastically eerie atmosphere, an intriguing multi-story terraced design, and a number of interesting new hero props. You’re going to have a blast with it! But I’d be careful asking Santa for anything during your visit, because he seems a little sus…

[h2]2 NEW HERO PROPS[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GDYePVI.gif[/img]
The reason that animatronic Santa seems so sus? That’s because the Spooky Santa is one of our new hero props! When he’s under the ghastly control of a Ghost, ol’ Saint Nick can get a little rough — The Spooky Santa can scoop up Hunters and whisk them away while doing choke damage to them for 5 seconds at a time.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hYlEpk8.gif[/img]
And what’s Santa without his little helpers? We’ve also added an Elf hero prop. These creepy little guys can throw ghoulish gifts at Hunters that can in turn ALSO be possessed! What a thoughtful gift.

[h2]2 NEW SKINS[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/KQdhqAG.jpeg[/img]
We’ve got two exciting new holiday-themed skins for all of you Ghosts and Hunters.

The Jolly Hunter is kitted out in traditional seasonal garb, including an antlered Santa hat, but he also comes complete with some Christmas light-inspired high-tech ghost-hunting gear. Give it a go to show off your holiday cheer and to ward off Ghosts of Christmas Past, Present, or Yet-To-Come. 

When you put on your Ghost hat, you can also don some seasonal apparel! The Krampus Ghost skin is sure to get you into the holiday spirit as you hide from stealthy Hunters. This goat-horned ghoul in his tattered robes takes inspiration from European folklore, and he does so with wicked style.

[h2]NEW PROGRESSION TIER SYSTEM[/h2]
In this update, we’ve also made leveling much more fun. Every 25 levels, players are promoted to a new tier with a unique profile picture border and title to display their hide-and-seek prowess. The tiers are as follows:
[list]
[*] Apprentice Hunter
[*] Professional Hunter
[*] Expert Hunter
[*] Ace Hunter
[*] Elite Hunter
[*] Master Hunter
[*] Grandmaster Hunter
[*] Legendary Hunter
[/list]
Each tier also has its own ranks, so after surpassing Apprentice Hunter I, you’ll become Apprentice Hunter II. After Apprentice Hunter III, you are Professional Hunter I, and so on. This change is purely cosmetic, no gear resets or matchmaking changes here.

This just adds a bit more fun to leveling and, of course, also means you get to flex your Grandmaster status when playing with your Apprentice friends over the holidays. 😏

[h2]BOT IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
In order to improve the player experience, we’ve taken some time to give some much-needed love to our Hunter and Ghost bots. You’ll notice that now, they navigate maps more effectively, and there have been some improvements to how they fire weapons. This is an area we think could benefit from further improvement, so keep an eye out in 2023 for additional fixes and upgrades.

[h2]UPDATED SOUNDTRACK & BOOMBOX[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1951320/Midnight_Ghost_Hunt_Soundtrack/
As we work closer and closer to having a fully finished soundtrack, we have a new song for the MGH Soundtrack out today, [i]Scarythingsinthedark.jpeg (with Brick Jones)[/i]! The extended version of [i]Where Are You?[/i] and [i]The Dark[/i] have both been added to the Soundtrack as well!

We wouldn’t want to leave the Boombox out of the fun, so all 3 of these songs have been added/updated in the Boombox in-game as well! 🎶

ALSO, we have updated the Win/Lose sounds, and added some new ambient tracks that play in the background while you are playing, so be sure to check them out!

[h2]HOST MIGRATION AND DEDICATED SERVERS ARE IN THE WORKS[/h2]
As mentioned in previous updates, we’ve been hard at work trying to implement Host Migration functionality, as well as adding Dedicated Servers. These are of course still in the works, but they’re quite a complex undertaking! As such, we’ve recently expanded our programming team to help get these changes out to all of you as quickly as we possibly can and create the best version of MGH we can. Despite growing our team, however, it looks like this work will continue into the start of the year. We appreciate your patience, and hope to have an update on this for you all soon!

[h2]UPDATED ROADMAP[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RZPMSLS.png[/img]
We have updated our roadmap to reflect our current projected release time for Dedicated Servers and Host Migration, as well as some hints to what is in store for Q1 for us here at MGH HQ.

[h2]50% OFF SALE[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/915810/Midnight_Ghost_Hunt/
In addition to the Christmas Update, we also are now having a 50% off sale! MGH makes a great gift for your squad, so if you want to play with your friends and avoid any last-minute Christmas shopping (specifically at any eerie and potentially haunted malls, for example) now is a great time to get an extra copy for a friend who could use a little extra spooky in their holiday season!

MGH will be on sale from [b]December 22nd to January 5th[/b]!

And… that’s it for 2022! As we wrap up this incredible year, we want to thank all of you in the MGH community for your continued support, and wish you all a great holiday season! We know that 2023 will have some incredible and exciting things in store for MGH, so keep an eye out for those, and we’ll see you all next year!

👻-Team MGH!

Hey Ghosts and Hunters,

We’re back with another exciting and festive update to help you kick off the holiday season. Update 4 (Thanksgiving Update) includes a new boombox, new hero props, festive decorations, and even a brand new Hunter Gadget. 

Update 4 will be the perfect way to shake off that post-turkey lethargy this Thanksgiving, so let’s dive on into the meat of what you can expect!

[h2]NEW FEATURE: BOOMBOX[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8Tfzzir.gif[/img]
This is a fun new feature that I think a lot of you are going to love. We’ve added the Boombox - a sweet retro-style boombox (familiar to all you Satisfactory fans) that you can use to play your favorite Coffee Stain game music in MGH. You can collect music cassettes found spread out across the various maps to unlock tracks to play on the boombox. You can find a boombox in the van, at the generator, and across the maps. If you’re a Hunter, you can use it to DJ your van ride, and Ghosts can even possess a boombox and play their favorite tunes while chasing you!

The cassettes you find will include music from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/548430/Deep_Rock_Galactic/]Deep Rock Galactic[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/526870/Satisfactory/]Satisfactory[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/598550/HUNTDOWN/]Huntdown[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/867210/Songs_of_Conquest/]Songs of Conquest[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/91600/Sanctum/]Sanctum[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/265930/Goat_Simulator/]Goat Sim[/url], so you’ll have tons of tunes to choose from.

[h2]2 NEW SOUNDTRACK SONGS[/h2]

To go along side the release of the boombox, we are also releasing 2 new songs on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1951320/Midnight_Ghost_Hunt_Soundtrack/]official soundtrack[/url], [b][i]Something is Happening, But I Can’t See It[/i][/b] and [b][i]Don’t Leave Me Now[/i][/b] - be sure to check them out!

[h2]NEW HUNTER GADGET: CAMCORDER[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/mSxADZM.gif[/img]
This new gadget is great because it mixes fun and useful functionality with a bit of tactical mischief. The new Camcorder gadget can be deployed by Hunters to watch over a given area, meaning that Ghosts running past will be tagged and made visible to Hunters for 10 seconds. Ghosts, however, are free to possess it to move it around, so it makes for a fun high-value possession target! Give this gadget a go and be sure to share your thoughts, because we’re dying to hear your opinions!

[h2]THANKSGIVING DECORATIONS[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZPkCwTi.png[/img]
It wouldn’t be a MGH holiday without a little fun flair! Naturally, we’ve taken the opportunity to spruce up the maps and the van with a few festive Thanksgiving frills to help you feel the holiday vibe. Let us know what you think of the new digs on [url=https://discord.gg/midnightghosthunt]Discord[/url]!

[h2]TURKEY-TASTIC HERO PROPS[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/NO2110U.gif[/img]
There’s no way to discuss this new Hero Prop that doesn’t sound absolutely absurd in the best way possible… You can possess a tasty, juicy turkey. You can run around frantically like a chicken with its head cut off, while inhabiting the tasty form of a (beautifully animated!) seasonal entree. You will strike fear in the hearts of Hunters as you stalk them succulently. It is everything I never knew I wanted in MGH. It’s also a little creepy, conceptually, and I am here for it.

In addition to the crispy-fleshed fowl, you can also hop inside Pumpkin Pies and use their delightful Fall flavors to make Hunters wish they were never born. Hunters will have their field of view splatted for a short while if you land a headshot! Do yourself a favor and splat some Hunters in the face this Thanksgiving.

[h2]50% OFF SALE[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/915810/Midnight_Ghost_Hunt/
In addition to the Thanksgiving Update, we’ll also be kicking off the start of the winter holiday season with a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/915810/Midnight_Ghost_Hunt/]50% off sale[/url]! If your friends are looking for something fun to play during their winter break be sure to recommend MGH while it’s on sale! It also makes a great gift for your squad. MGH will be on sale from[b] November 22nd to the 29th[/b]!

That’s all for this time, Ghosts and Hunters. We’re wishing you a tremendous Turkey Day, and we hope you enjoy Update 4! As always, we look forward to hearing your thoughts on the update, so hop on over to [url=https://discord.gg/midnightghosthunt]Discord[/url] or give us a shout on [url=https://twitter.com/playmgh]Twitter[/url] with your thoughts!

👻-Team MGH!

notes.title: UPDATE 2, FREE WEEKEND, AND 50% SALE!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=oUz3xjkQFBY;full][/previewyoutube]
Hey Ghosts and Hunters,

We’ve just rolled out a hot and fresh new update for all you fearsome ghouls and ghastly hunters! Update 2 comes with a brand new map, a new ghost ability, new hunter skins, new titles, an exciting new hero prop, and a weekend full of fresh blood due to a[b] free weekend and a half off sale[/b]! Let’s dive on into the juicy details and take a peek at what we’ve cooked up now.

[h2]New Map: Carnival[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/eoNnEkp.jpeg[/img]
The biggest and one of the most exciting things in Update 2 is the Carnival, a.k.a. Mr. Giggle’s Happyland, a quirky carnival of terrors. This theme has long been awaited by many of you in the community, and it’s pretty clear you all have excellent taste! This charming festival of fear has some really great set pieces and areas, including an eerie merry-go-round, the Alien Arcade, a Wild West Saloon with bumper cars, and Mr. Giggle’s very own Haunted Mansion complete with dangerous animatronics.

[h2]New Ghost Ability: Deflector[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XyBBHRm.gif[/img]
Deflector can summon a wispy shield that will deflect incoming projectiles. The shield lasts for 5 seconds, but is cancelled if you attack just like Phantom does. This gives you the perfect opportunity to get away from danger, revive a teammate, or consume a Hunter’s soul. You can even try to bodyblock incoming fire towards your teammates. Note that the projectiles still hit somewhere, as they deflect off the side of the bubble shield.

The shield won’t defend you from melee attacks, so watch out for those Ghostsmashers and Sledgehammers. In our tests we have found Deflector to be quite effective, and really shake gameplay up a bit in fun ways.

Although the ability is cancelled if you attack, you can still use it to position yourself for a follow-up assault.

[h2]New Hunter Skins[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SbzF2ci.jpeg[/img]
Who’s ready for some new cosmetics? Yeah, me too. We’ve got three brand new Hunter skins for you all:

[b]Paramedic[/b] - fully outfitted with PPE, a medical vest, and a nifty stethoscope (it may not be functional, but it looks cool!)

[b]Pilot[/b] - a metal-studded fighter pilot with a sick flight suit

[b]Old Hippie[/b] - the 60s may be long gone, but they left their mark - the Old Hippie has some sweet and colorful duds with a pretty rad flower patch (y’know, the kind of patch you put on clothes)

[h2]New Hero Props[/h2]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/42MCLag.gif[/img]
If you caught the trailer for Update 2, you’ve probably seen some fun new hero props! If I were a Hunter, I’d be careful of the Jack-in-the-boxes or you might get bonked. There might also be some bumper cars that are exceedingly good at bumping away Hunters.

[h2]New Unlockable Titles[/h2]
In this update, we’ve made some improvements to Challenges - now when you complete a Challenge, it will display the Challenge you’ve completed to make it easier to keep up with those you’ve completed and move on to the next one. In addition to this improvement, we’ve got four new titles that you can now unlock by completing in-match Challenges. You can now unlock and use the following titles to show off your skills:
[list]
[*] Apprentice
[*] Master
[*] Grandmaster
[*]  Legend[/list]
[h2]New Song[/h2]
Ghostwood Empire has done it again! This new tune with a late 80s-inspired feel will most definitely give the Hunters a boost while they listen to it in the van on their way to hunt ghosts. The song “Flight of the Kite” is a tribute to nobody else but our favorite cat in a tophat (and lead dev 😉), Kite. The song has also been added to the Midnight Ghost Hunt Soundtrack.

[h2]Free Weekend and 50% Sale[/h2]
It’s always exciting for us when new people discover MGH. Even though we’re still in the early days of MGH and there’s a lot more coming, we want more folks to experience the magic with us. To support that discovery and to celebrate Update 2, this weekend we’ll be having a free weekend on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/915810/Midnight_Ghost_Hunt/]Steam[/url]! The free weekend will run from September 22nd to 26th.

Those of you who are checking out this post because you’ve newly fallen in love with MGH over the free weekend, you’re in luck! MGH is also [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/915810/Midnight_Ghost_Hunt/]now 50% off[/url], so there’s no better time to snag a copy. If you’re a new player concerned about carrying over your progress from the free weekend, worry not! All of your progress from throughout the free weekend will carry over if you decide to give it a test run first and purchase it on the last day of the deal.

In addition to the base game being on sale, you can also get 50% off the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25291/Early_Backer_Bundle/]Early Backer Bundle[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1938860/Midnight_Ghost_Hunt__Early_Backer_Pack/]Early Backer Pack[/url], and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1951320/Midnight_Ghost_Hunt_Soundtrack/]Soundtrack[/url] if you’d like to show a bit of extra support during our Early Access period.

[h2]Sick Fits - MGH Merch is now available[/h2]
[url=https://www.goodsmileus.com/fandom/midnight-ghost-hunt-1109][img]https://i.imgur.com/07mul1N.png[/img][/url]
If you want to rep your favorite prop hunt game, you can snag some sick fits over on our [url=https://www.goodsmileus.com/fandom/midnight-ghost-hunt-1109]brand new merch shop[/url]. We’ve got hoodies and shirts for that ectoplasmic drip, and you can get them both now.  The collection includes backpacks, mousepads, and posters, too. We’ve also got mugs, so you can enjoy your favorite drinks, but we can’t promise they come 100% unpossessed, so you may find yourself periodically wondering if it’s going to hop off the desk and attack you. It probably won’t, but might as well buy one now and find out!

[h2]Dedicated Servers and Host Migration coming VERY soon[/h2]
We have been working extremely hard on dedicated servers and host migration, and while we were striving to get them included in this update, they still need some final touches and more testing before we can roll it out to everyone. We expect these to be wrapped up very soon though, and we will be releasing them as soon as we feel they are ready. We know both of these features are very highly requested, and it is a number 1 priority for us to get them done. Thanks for being patient, and we should have some news to share on these very, very soon.

That’s all, folks! At least for now. 😏 The spooky season is approaching, though, so keep your eyes peeled for even more updates! We just might surprise you with something special. A great place to get your news and updates is our [url=https://discord.gg/midnightghosthunt]Discord server[/url], where players and our team hang out on the daily. [img]https://i.imgur.com/rd9sJoP.jpeg[/img]

Before we start looking further afield in regards to our roadmap, it’s important to mention that we have quite a juicy patch incoming! Hot off the heels of Patch 10 comes… [b]THE SUMMER PATCH[/b]! Alright, maybe the naming convention could use some work, but this is somewhere between a patch and an update.

[b]Full Changelog:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new in-match challenge system to get extra shard rewards. You are assigned optional challenges that may prompt you to try different methods of gameplay for some bonus ghost shards. These are a new system that is fairly experimental, let us know what you think!
[*] New Hero Prop: Ghost in the TV on Museum, School, and Asylum. This new unique TV possessable prop contains an angry Ghost that will swipe out from the TV to score some melee damage! Comes complete with spooky sounds

[*] Fixed potential issue causing slowdown if player has many replay files. This limits maximum replays to 20, so make sure to copy any replays you are very proud of
[*] Fixed issue where clients in custom games could get achievement progress
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]THE ROADMAP[/h2]

After a great deal of thinking and planning, we’ve put together a look at what we hope to accomplish in the remainder of the year!

Behold, the MGH Roadmap for the second half of 2022!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kMUuJGG.jpeg[/img]

There’s lots of exciting stuff on here, but let’s start at the beginning! Quarter 3 is the period from the start of July until the end of September. This year, there’s a bit more to look forward to in Q3 than just two awesome months of summer and the start of the changing of the leaves, though. We’ve got big plans!

One of the biggest upcoming features, as you can see in the image above, is the addition of dedicated servers as an option. We’ve started the process of working on this, and hope to have it completed sometime in Q3! Alongside this, we are also working on host migration in P2P hosted sessions. This is a large undertaking from a technical perspective, but both of these features should result in much smoother gameplay and improved stability overall.

Q3 will also have a lot of new content, including a new map, more hero props, more cosmetics like skins, emotes, and victory poses, and of course an updated roadmap to keep you in the loop of future plans and to ensure our timelines are still on track with the realities of development. All things considered, Q3 is looking excellent!

Q4 (the period from October 1st-December 31st) will take us through peak spooky season in the fall, and right to the season of giving. And we’ll be giving all of you some tricks and treats between now and then to be sure! In Q4, we'll be looking to add additional content such as a new map, additional hero props, cosmetics, and... new gear and abilities! We've got some great ideas cooking up, so be sure to keep your eyes on our roadmap moving forward to stay in the loop of when those will drop!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]THE EARLY ACCESS WISHLIST[/h2]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7VBXybR.jpeg[/img]

Looking far out to the horizon, we see in the distance the end of Early Access. That’s a ways off, as there’s still a lot we’d like to accomplish while in Early Access. As you can see from the roadmap above, we want to add several new maps and map variations, lots of great props, new things to do in the game, loads of new cosmetics, gear, and abilities, and maybe even a new game mode that'll keep you having fun with MGH for a long time to come.

As this is still a ways off, we can’t say too much about it just yet, but we wanted to keep you all on the same page with our vision for what’s to come!

[hr][/hr]
[h3]ONE FINAL NOTE[/h3]

You might see things slow down a bit during July as far as new content/features are concerned. A lot of our lovely dev team is based in Sweden, and it is pretty common that around July/August, basically everyone in Sweden goes on vacation for a few weeks. So while we will still be fixing bugs and making changes, things will slow down for a few weeks while some of the team takes a well deserved break.

Thanks for your feedback and bug reports as always! If you haven't already, join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/midnightghosthunt]Discord[/url]!

See you on the hunt!
- Team MGH

[*] Radar gadget now detects other ghostly activity, such as Corrupted props, floating Poltergeist props, Death Grip traps, Trickster props, and Apparitions. This provides Ghosts with other counterplays to Radar-heavy Hunter teams besides moving/taunting to lower ectoplasm buildup

notes.title: Early Access Patch 1
notes.content:
Hey all! It has been 1 week since we launched into early access - thanks again everyone for your incredible support and feedback! It's been a blast playing and discussing with you all.

Over the past week, the team has been listening and focusing on how best to address common feedback and complaints without disrupting what people seem to be enjoying the most.

As a quick note, we are aware of the prop damage/hit registration issues, and while we don't have a fix ready for that in this patch, it is high on the team's priority list and will ideally improve this in the next patch.

We've just released our first patch in an attempt to address various feedback and reports we've been getting from the community, and here's what you can expect from it!

[b]Patch Notes[/b]

[list]
[*] By default, Quick Play-created games now end after 2 matches and put everyone back into queue. This should help mix up the matches a bit and improve our matchmaker pool significantly. Server browser-created games are not affected. Players can vote on a rematch to continue the rounds as desired
[*] XP/Shards are now granted as soon as the game is over, rather than waiting until after the MVP screen. This will ideally improve host quits to deny progress
[*] New "lobby code" system: Share the code to make it easier for your friends to join your lobby
[*] Added 4 new languages: French, Spanish, Polish, and Brazilian Portuguese. More to come!
[*] BONUS NEW EMOTE: Rainbow!
[*] Harpoon Bazooka now has a reload/cooldown animation to make it less spammable, and the duration of Harpoon attachment reduced
[*] Untrappable Ghost Perk now works as a counter to Harpoon as well by making the duration much shorter
[*] Reaper is now less accurate while moving/not scoped in. Movement speed increases inaccuracy while hip firing
[*] Pinging a player now will only track them for 2.5 seconds instead of 4, allowing for more escapes
[*] Minor prop health and speed adjustments, and Ghost form is slightly faster now
[*] Streamer mode improvements, now hides lobby name, invite code, and team text chat
[*] Added option to turn off the auto-balancer in Server Tools
[*] Vacuum and Consume XP set to 50XP down from 100XP due to outshining kills in MVP screen
[*] Fix issue where you could not apply some resolution settings in the video options menu
[*] Password entry is no longer visible plaintext
[*] Potentially fixed memory issue while sitting in the friend invite screen for awhile
[*] Fix "Generator Under Attack" sound not playing
[*] Many map collision problems and unintended hiding spots fixed
[*] It should be less likely for NA and Asian lobbies to end up together, though this is something we are continuing to adjust
[*] Many more bug fixes
[/list]

A note on Anti-cheat: we are currently working with our anti-cheat provider to improve overall reliability, there have been some improvements as we go but not completely solved as of this patch. We will keep everyone posted on our progress.

Thanks for all of your feedback and bug reports, they have been tremendously helpful! If you haven't already, join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/midnightghosthunt]Discord[/url], where we have channels setup to make it super easy to tell us all about any bugs you run into or any feedback you might have!

notes.title: REVIEW OF EARLY ACCESS DAY 1!
notes.content:
Greeting Ghosts, and Hello Hunters! 👋

We launched into Early Access yesterday! The entire team here would like to express our most heartfelt thank you to all of you who’ve already purchased the game, the Early Backer Pack/Bundle, or soundtrack. We appreciate the support immensely and will continue to improve upon the game as we continue through Early Access!

It’s been an absolute joy to play with you all, chat about the game, and check all of your wonderful MGH creations - whether they were memes, screenshots, YouTube videos, or live streams. We love to see that, and hope to see them coming! 😊

WHERE TO FIND US

There are a couple of things we wanted to point out to make sure that you can access all the information that’s out there. We have a wonderful, active [url=https://discord.gg/midnightghosthunt]Discord [/url]community where you can discuss the game, look for a group to play with, give us valuable feedback, post memes, and screenshots, and promote your stream or channel.

If you come across any pesky bugs while playing, you can report them over at [url=https://midnightghosthunt.featureupvote.com/]https://midnightghosthunt.featureupvote.com/[/url] As a quick reminder, we want to point out that our board at Feature Upvote is solely for bug reporting. Feedback and suggestions can be discussed over on our Discord.

You can also join us on [url=https://twitter.com/PlayMGH]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/MidnightGhostHunt/]Reddit[/url]! 


INCOMING UPDATES

We have a long list of languages on their way to MGH:
French
Spanish
Polish
Brazilian Portuguese
Korean
Italian

These will be added to the ones already in-game:
English
German
Russian
Chinese (simplified)

We’ve also gone through your feedback and are keeping a close eye on the matchmaking concerns, as well as Harpoon Bazooka balance.

Matchmaking is something we’re continuing to look at, and it appears related to how many players often find one good lobby and play there for awhile, instead of being thrown back into the matchmaking queue after a few games. So the amount of open slots available tend to be reduced at any given time. We’re looking into ways to reduce the chance of being put into very high ping lobbies as much as we can.

Teams of Hunters stacking the Harpoon Bazooka is also something we’re looking into. There’s a few potential routes we could take here, be sure to let us know your thoughts on our Discord. We’ll try some things internally and keep you all posted.

We’ve also heard about hosts leaving before XP and shards are granted. This will be improved in an upcoming update, with XP/shards being granted immediately on game over instead of when the top players screen appears a bit later.

Eventually, we will set up a way for shards/XP to be granted as you go in a match, though that may take some time to implement and test properly.

We’ve seen the discussion about dedicated servers - this is something the team is working on with high priority. We were hoping to have them in for launch, though we hit some technical hurdles. We’ll continue to work on them and hope to have them ready in a future update. Stay tuned for news on that.

On a lighter note, a little bird told me there are some cool new emotes in the works, too, so remember to keep an eye out! 👀

See you on the hunt!

notes.title: Early Access March 31st & Closed Beta March 28th!
notes.content:
Hey Ghosts and Hunters,

Another week with more exciting news! This time around, we’ve got a release date for you, as well as an awesome new cinematic trailer. 

[b]THE BIG ANNOUNCEMENT[/b]
Today at the Future Games Show, we announced that we are releasing into Steam Early Access on March 31st, at a price of $19.99! This is wildly exciting for our team, as we’ve been working for years to develop Midnight Ghost Hunt, and now we’re finally closing in on the day it’s available to everyone.

[b]THE TRAILER[/b]
As mentioned, we also released an incredible new cinematic trailer today. We’re excited to share this with all of you, as we’ve been working on it for quite some time. It definitely evokes the spirit of MGH, and it’s awesome (if we do say so ourselves). Be sure to check it out!

[previewyoutube=3ztQKudjLiA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]ONWARD TO EARLY ACCESS![/b]
Now that you’ve watched the cinematic trailer and you’re all pumped for Early Access (...you DID watch it, right?) we can let you in on a little secret. Before we get to Early Access, we’ve got one last hurrah planned. On March 28th, we’ll kick off a two-day closed beta!

All of you long-time players have one more chance to sharpen your hiding and hunting skills! This is also a fantastic opportunity for some of you who have never had the chance to play to get another crack at experiencing MGH before it kicks off worldwide.

While we won’t be able to grant access to everyone, new players can still request access to this Beta on our Steam store page for a chance to get to play during the Beta period. We’re planning to really open the flood gates for this final test, so we’ll do our best to give access to as many folks as we can manage.

Also, this beta will [b]NOT BE UNDER NDA[/b]! Content creators rejoice, it’s finally time! 🙏

Here’s some of what’s new for our final beta:

[b]CUSTOM GAME OPTIONS[/b]
This is by far the biggest feature we’ve added since our last test. With custom game options, you can take even more control of server settings to randomize loadouts, choose which weapons to allow and which to ban, and even do things like adjust movement speeds or give everyone a mystery loadout! This should make for all sorts of fun scenarios (who doesn’t like 5x movement speed and only weapons that make for big booms?!), and we can’t wait to see what crazy game modes you all come up with!

[b]NEW HERO PROPS[/b]
We’ve also added two new hero props to MGH! The new hero props are… T-Rex Head and the Skeleton! We’ll leave it up to you to figure out where you can find them, what they do, and how they work. Suffice it to say T-Rex Head has more than a little bite to it!

[b]FIRE, FURY, AND BALANCE[/b]
As we’ve had the balancing of the Flamethrower on our minds for quite some time, we’ve decided to make it a heavy weapon from now on, similar to Project-X. Gone are the days of rapidly razing every prop in sight to the ground - now you’ll need to employ a more measured pace when using the Flamethrower, as your movement speed will be reduced while it’s equipped.

[b]COOKING WITH A BANG[/b]
Grenades can now be cooked and will cause self-damage if cooked too long (just like mom’s macaroni recipe) or if standing too close to their explosion radius, similarly to C4.

[b]LIFE TRACKING[/b]
In order to prevent players from quitting games and rejoining to be alive again, we’ve implemented a new life tracking system. Now players won’t be able to game the system by hopping in and out of servers.

[b]ACCESSIBILITY - COLOR VISION DEFICIENCY OPTIONS[/b]
We want as many people as possible to be able to play and enjoy MGH. To make that easier for our friends with color vision deficiency, we’ve added a first pass feature aimed at easing the difficulties of play they experience. We intend to continue improving this feature for the future, so if you experience color vision deficiency, be sure to let us know how this works for you!

[b]SHOW ‘EM HOW YOU FEEL[/b]
There will be [b]FIVE[/b] new emotes to try out with this beta!
[list]
[*]Admire the Duck
[*]Kung-Fu
[*]So Scary
[*]Nirvana
[*]Peek-a-boo[/list]
[b]NEW VICTORY POSES[/b]
We’ve added 13 new unlockable options for victory poses! Of course, you’ll need to win to use them yourself, so… best of luck!

[b]NEW HUNTER SKINS[/b]
We have added several new Hunter skins and have reworked a couple of the existing ones as well! Let us know which one is your favorite!

[b]TITLES AND ACHIEVEMENTS[/b]
In addition to victory poses and emotes, we’ve also added 29 Titles, and 42 Achievements for you to unlock!

[b]RECENT PLAYERS LIST[/b]
In order to make it easier for you to add new friends and connect with awesome players (and report ones the less awesome ones who left before you had a chance to report them), we’ve added a recent players list. You can find it in the add to party panel.

[b]NEW VAN AND RIDE-INS[/b]
Last but not least, we’ve hooked you all up with a new whip. The van has been totally redone, and vehicle ride-ins are much more realistic now! There’s stuff to look at, the vehicles turn and maneuver, and the experience is overall more dynamic and enjoyable. And before you ask… yes, you can still spray your profile picture in the van - don’t worry!

And much much more - we will publish a full changelog as usual on Discord when the closed Beta goes live!

That about wraps it up this time around, Ghosts and Hunters. We really hope you’ve enjoyed the cinematic trailer, and we look forward to playing with you all in the upcoming Beta and then Early Access. If you haven’t yet, be sure to wishlist MGH on Steam ahead of the Early Access launch to be notified when MGH is finally available for everyone. We’d love to hear all your thoughts regarding the last Beta, Early Access, and all things MGH so let’s chat over on [url=https://discord.com/invite/MidnightGhostHunt]Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/playmgh]Twitter[/url]!
